research_notes: Follow-up: date Koori Information Centre, health/funeral/children's-services and Centrelink jobs; identify payroll entities, hours and breaks. Obtain Lake Tyers, council, MAV and business contracts/governance records, including 2010–2013 overlap. Resolve undated consulting, NAIDOC pay, Clan control and inter-parliamentary roles.

Reviewed 2026-09-29: APH, own profile, fellowship profile, Victorian former-member page and MAV 2012/13 report. MAV p35 lists Thorpe as Aboriginal Employment Adviser; p36 says grant-funded group had ten full-time and ten part-time staff. No individual allocation is given.

MAV is statutorily incorporated under the Municipal Association Act 1907, but statute and government grants alone do not settle control/sector. Keep unresolved pending governance/control analysis. Own-business experience is attested but not mapped conclusively to every named directorship.

Victoria's official page gives 19 December 2018 end, distinct from election-loss day; retain sourced date and do not infer earnings through it. Frozen federal roster party and start retained. No political views or controversies used as career evidence. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; unresolved initial record.

2026-10-02 follow-up: co-authored report adds omitted advisory clients and Greens commission; do not sum concurrent engagements. Seven-year funeral-service account has no calendar/FTE bounds. Appointment reporting confirms OurWatch work and provides Amnesty2020 snapshot, with APH2019 start retained. Targeted council/MAV hours and early-employer searches still leave FTE, control, dates and contractual entities unresolved.2019 candidate booklet yielded indexed funeral-service lead but subsequent retrieval redirected to Gellung Warl homepage; insufficient to resolve legal employer. Full-time wording in senator-office job advertisements describes staff vacancies, not Thorpe. Next: original consulting contracts/entity, MAV individual appointment/control evidence and early employment chronology; no years calculated.

2026-10-03 follow-up materially resolves the previously unidentified children's-services job: Thorpe told the Senate she was Yappera's cook at17. Her known birth date gives an age window of18August1990–17August1991, but no appointment boundaries, duration or hours, so dates remain unknown and no FTE is inferred. Employer material confirms Yappera opened in1981 and is now an Aboriginal-controlled nonprofit; current control is not back-cast. A2018 profile says she resigned from Centrelink after Welfare to Work was introduced, but the wording cannot establish a precise cessation date or full-time status. Official ParlInfo retrieval returned403; the accessible OpenAustralia Hansard reproduction was used. Searches did not resolve Koori, health, funeral, Lake Tyers, council or MAV individual terms, consulting entities or overlaps. Next: historical Yappera/early-employer records, Centrelink appointment and cessation evidence, and MAV/council personnel records. No duration calculated.

2026-10-04 follow-up: exact-phrase searches for the seven-year Aboriginal funeral-service work found the existing first-person 7am interview and Thorpe's current official biography, but neither names the employer or supplies calendar boundaries, hours, leave or control. The current biography also says she served six years in local government, consistent with the already recorded 2011–2016 council/MAV sequence but not enough to treat either role as continuous full-time service. Generic web search is exhausted for this pass; funeral-service organisational/payroll records and council/MAV appointment records remain decisive. No substantive fact changed.
